newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Cash cattle look steady to firm and beef prices little higher.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Large drop in index was expected while lower corn futures may lend support.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Pork cutout lower and hogs called steady to lower, but hog runs light.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Further weakness in cash product but reports due later Tuesday.
